name: @arkesoft/db
description: Prisma şeması, migration’lar, seed ve RLS politikaları

scripts.migrate: pnpm run build && node dist/run-guarded-prisma.js migrate dev
scripts.push: pnpm run build && node dist/run-guarded-prisma.js db push
scripts.seed: pnpm run build && node dist/run-guarded-prisma.js db seed
scripts.studio: pnpm run build && node dist/run-guarded-prisma.js studio
scripts.reset: pnpm run build && node dist/run-guarded-prisma.js migrate reset
scripts.verify: prisma validate && prisma format --check && prisma migrate diff --from-config-datasource --to-schema prisma/schema.prisma --exit-code
